name: Dark Hairline Terminal
tagline: Near-black canvas framed by one-pixel gray hairlines, tight Inter Tight headlines, indigo accent and mono terminal blocks (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Neo-Swiss near-black with gray hairline grid and a single indigo accent

typography.style: Tight-tracked semibold Inter Tight with JetBrains Mono uppercase labels and command blocks

best_for: Developer tools, CLIs and infrastructure products that want a quiet, terminal-flavored look. Suits technical audiences who prefer data over decoration.
avoid_for: Warm consumer or celebratory stories that need color and personality.
